summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper fetches Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, which unconditionally downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts and chmod+x's the platform-specific Bun binary to a temp directory, and then invokes it against the sibling `math_init.js` — a ~727KB obfuscated Bun-cjs bundle (marked with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, a large hex-encoded string-array constant `n7gIxM` with a `WV8StW` array-rotator, and mangled `_0x...` identifiers). The declared purpose of the package is a shared CSS repo config, which has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime nor an opaque compiled payload; the shipped `math_init.js` is not readable as source and there are no build artifacts or configuration files that would explain executing it. The published version 15.1.12 also diverges from the shipped CHANGELOG, whose top entry is 15.1.1, and the `preinstall` hook does not appear in prior releases. Running `npm install` executes attacker-selected code on the installer via a second runtime fetched at install time, bypassing Node-based install sandboxes and scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
